test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e31d6c3cbbe13d5a47ab5f1967217602137c6342f92364e256dc86e862826d6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a237abf1ea414bbbfedf4854f8f5dc43a766dc64930f7598ac5880967289c94.png] 

3 × 3 × 5 × 2 = 15 × 6

90 = 90 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854c79b45b7c5b5862b8937347b14979fb359ac5706f1c534b71428cffa1cd65.png] 

2 × 4 × 6 × 1 = 12 × 4

48 = 48 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e117a21262d0c96aff81fed7620fdf20a79ca45065481d420fab7b9dd100bb8.png] 

2 × 3 × 4 × 2 = 4 × ?

48 ÷ 4 = ?

**12 = ?**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
